quests.name: The Everlook Report
quests.text: Deliver the Everlook Report to Argent Officer Pureheart at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: The Everlook Report
quests.text: Deliver the Everlook Report to Argent Officer Garush at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff
quests.text: Deliver the book, "Studies in Spirit Speaking", to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: A Strange One
quests.text: Speak with Winna Hazzard in Felwood.

quests.name: Chillwind Horns
quests.text: Bring 8 Uncracked Chillwind Horns to Felnok Steelspring.

quests.name: Return to Tinkee
quests.text: Bring Felnok's Package to Tinkee Steamboil in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Winterfall Ritual Totem
quests.text: Take the Winterfall Ritual Totem inside Timbermaw Hold and see if one of the furbolgs there will find a use for the item. The Timbermaw will not speak with you unless you are of Neutral reputation or greater with them.

quests.name: Strange Sources
quests.text: Follow Donova Snowden's instructions, then report back.

quests.name: Are We There, Yeti?
quests.text: Collect 10 Thick Yeti Furs for Umi Rumplesnicker in Everlook.

quests.name: Threat of the Winterfall
quests.text: Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to kill 8 Winterfall Pathfinders, 8 Winterfall Den Watchers, and 8 Winterfall Totemics.

quests.name: Winterfall Firewater
quests.text: Bring the Empty Firewater Flask to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

quests.name: Falling to Corruption
quests.text: Search the Deadwood furbolg camp in northern Felwood for a clue.

quests.name: Mystery Goo
quests.text: Report back to Donova Snowden with your findings.

quests.name: Toxic Horrors
quests.text: Collect 3 Toxic Horror Droplets for Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

quests.name: Trouble in Winterspring!
quests.text: Find Donova Snowden near the hot springs in Winterspring.

quests.name: Ursius of the Shardtooth
quests.text: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Ursius.

quests.name: The Ruins of Kel'Theril
quests.text: Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper in Starfall Village.

quests.name: Troubled Spirits of Kel'Theril
quests.text: Use Jaron's Pick to find the four Highborne Relic Fragments. Bring them to Aurora Skycaller in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Wildkin of Elune
quests.text: Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

quests.name: Winterfall Runners
quests.text: Find the Winterfall Runners and stop them from delivering their shipment to Winterfall Village.

quests.name: Are We There, Yeti?
quests.text: Collect 2 Pristine Yeti Horns for Umi Rumplesnicker in Everlook.

quests.name: Are We There, Yeti?
quests.text: Take Umi's Mechanical Yeti and scare her friends with it:  Legacki in Everlook (Winterspring) Sprinkle in Gadgetzan (Tanaris) Quixxil in Marshal's Refuge (Un'Goro Crater)  When you are done, bring the Mechanical Yeti back to Umi.

quests.name: Brumeran of the Chillwind
quests.text: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Brumeran.

quests.name: Remorseful Highborne
quests.text: Speak with Wynd Nightchaser in Starfall Village, and ask about the proper place for the Crystal of Zin-Malor.

quests.name: The Crystal of Zin-Malor
quests.text: Deliver the Crystal of Zin-Malor to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

quests.name: Shardtooth Pulling
quests.text: Remove 12 Elder Shardtooth from nearby areas, then return to Sarna Brownhorn.

quests.name: Guarding Secrets
quests.text: Take the Blue-feathered Necklace to Trull Failbane at Bloodvenom Post.

quests.name: Guarding Secrets
quests.text: Take the Blue-feathered Necklace to Nara Wildmane.

quests.name: Guardians of the Altar
quests.text: Protect Ranshalla while she attempts to reactivate the Altar of Elune. Report your findings to Erelas Ambersky in Rut'theran Village.

objectives.text: Discover the secret of the Altar of Elune

quests.name: High Chief Winterfall
quests.text: Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to defeat High Chief Winterfall.

quests.name: The Final Piece
quests.text: Bring the Crudely-written Log to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

quests.name: Words of the High Chief
quests.text: Take the Crudely-written Log to Kelek Skykeeper in southern Felwood.

quests.name: Enraged Wildkin
quests.text: Locate Jaron Stoneshaper's wrecked camp and supplies in southern Winterspring.

quests.name: Enraged Wildkin
quests.text: Find Jaron Stoneshaper's wrecked wagon.

quests.name: Enraged Wildkin
quests.text: Pick up Jaron's Supplies from the snow, then find the wildkin that stole the amulet Jaron spoke of.  Bring Jaron's Supplies and the Blue-feathered Amulet to Jaron Stoneshaper at the lodge in Winterspring.

quests.name: Enraged Wildkin
quests.text: Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper at Starfall Village.

quests.name: Two-Headed Ravagers
quests.text: Kill 15 Chillwind Ravagers and return to Rilan Howard in northern Winterspring.

quests.name: Too Bad to Bear
quests.text: Kill the old shardtooth matriarchs, Kuroma and Kamuro, and return their heads to Sarna Brownhorn.

quests.name: Sweet Serenity
quests.text: Travel to Stratholme and kill the Crimson Hammersmith. Recover the Crimson Hammersmith's Apron and return to Lilith.

quests.name: Snakestone of the Shadow Huntress
quests.text: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin. Recover Vosh'gajin's Snakestone and return to Kilram.

quests.name: Corruption
quests.text: Find the Black Guard Swordsmith in Stratholme and destroy him. Recover the Insignia of the Black Guard and return to Seril Scourgebane.

quests.name: Shy-Rotam
quests.text: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to defeat Shy-Rotam.

quests.name: Luck Be With You
quests.text: Collect 4 Frostmaul Shards for Witch Doctor Mau'ari in Everlook.

quests.name: Cache of Mau'ari
quests.text: Speak to Witch Doctor Mau'ari again in a moment to receive the lucky charm.

quests.name: Fiery Plate Gauntlets
quests.text: Bring Malyfous Darkhammer 6 Enchanted Thorium Bars, 2 Essence of Fire, and 4 Star Rubies. You will also need to turn in your Unfired Plate Gauntlets.

quests.name: Lorax's Tale
quests.text: Speak with Lorax. Listen to what he has to say.

quests.name: A Little Luck
quests.text: Speak with Witch Doctor Mau'ari in Everlook.

quests.name: Cap of the Scarlet Savant
quests.text: In order to create the Cap of the Scarlet Savant, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 5 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 8 Arcane Crystals; 5 Enchanted Scarlet Thread.   You will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item.

quests.name: Leggings of Arcana
quests.text: In order to create the Leggings of Arcana, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 5 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 5 Arcanite Bars; 5 Frostwhisper's Embalming Fluid.  You will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item.

quests.name: Breastplate of Bloodthirst
quests.text: In order to create the Breastplate of Bloodthirst, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 10 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 5 Arcanite Bars; 5 Skin of Shadow.  You will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item.

quests.name: Wrath of the Blue Flight
quests.text: Speak with Haleh if you wish to continue.

quests.name: Frostsaber Provisions
quests.text: Collect 5 Shardtooth Meats and 5 Chillwind Meats for Rivern Frostwind in Winterspring.

quests.name: Winterfall Intrusion
quests.text: Rivern Frostwind wants you to slay 5 Winterfall Shaman and 5 Winterfall Ursa.

quests.name: Rampaging Giants
quests.text: Rivern Frostwind wants you to kill 4 Frostmaul Giants and 4 Frostmaul Preservers.
